description: This Java class provides job parameters for a loan COB (Close of Business) batch process within the Fineract framework. It retrieves business date details, manages job parameters, and associates them with a specific job name.

classes.name: LoanCOBJobParameterProvider
classes.description: A Spring component that provides job parameters for the Loan COB process, ensuring the inclusion of the correct business date and linking parameters to the specific job.

methods.name: provide
methods.description: Generates job parameters, saves them via repository, and adds the custom job parameter ID to the parameter map.

methods.name: getJobName
methods.description: Returns the name of the job, specifically 'LOAN_COB'.

methods.name: getJobParameterDTOListWithCorrectBusinessDate
methods.description: Ensures the job parameter set includes a business date parameter; adds it if missing, based on the current COB date.
